item.description: The current implementation of Flask route decoration in hook_flask function overwrites existing endpoint functions due to incorrect handling of Flask's route decorator mechanism. The route_wrapper function incorrectly passes the hooked function to the original route decorator, causing conflicts with Flask's internal endpoint mapping.
item.contract: Modify the Flask route decoration mechanism to properly integrate with Flask's routing system without overwriting existing endpoint functions. The hook should capture route information and apply the hook to the function while preserving Flask's original routing behavior.
